reference_sql:
WITH gaps AS (
  -- one row per app event of the four users in November 2025
  SELECT event_id, user_id, event_ts,
    LAG(event_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_ts, event_id) AS prev_ts
  FROM app_events
  WHERE user_id IN (17, 128, 129, 278)
    AND event_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-11-01 00:00:00+00'
    AND event_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-12-01 00:00:00+00'
), flagged AS (
  -- one row per app event of the four users in November 2025
  SELECT event_id, user_id, event_ts,
    CASE WHEN prev_ts IS NULL OR event_ts - prev_ts > INTERVAL '30 minutes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session
  FROM gaps
), numbered AS (
  -- one row per app event of the four users in November 2025
  SELECT user_id, event_ts,
    SUM(new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_ts, event_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
  FROM flagged
)
SELECT user_id, session_no, MIN(event_ts) AS session_start, COUNT(*) AS events,
  epoch(MAX(event_ts)) - epoch(MIN(event_ts)) AS length_seconds
FROM numbered
GROUP BY user_id, session_no

      OR epoch(event_ts) - epoch(LAG(event_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_ts, event_id)) > 1800 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session

WITH gaps AS (
  -- one row per app event of the four users in November 2025
  SELECT event_id, user_id, event_ts,
    LAG(event_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_ts, event_id) AS prev_ts
  FROM app_events
  WHERE user_id IN (17, 128, 129, 278)
    AND event_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-11-01 00:00:00+00'
    AND event_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-12-01 00:00:00+00'
), starts AS (
  -- one row per session start
  SELECT user_id, event_ts AS session_start,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_ts) AS session_no,
    LEAD(event_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_ts) AS next_start
  FROM gaps
  WHERE prev_ts IS NULL OR event_ts - prev_ts > INTERVAL '30 minutes'
)
SELECT s.user_id, s.session_no, s.session_start, COUNT(*) AS events,
  epoch(MAX(g.event_ts)) - epoch(s.session_start) AS length_seconds
FROM starts s
JOIN gaps g ON g.user_id = s.user_id AND g.event_ts >= s.session_start
  AND (s.next_start IS NULL OR g.event_ts < s.next_start)
GROUP BY s.user_id, s.session_no, s.session_start

solver.query:
WITH f AS (SELECT event_id, user_id, event_ts, CASE WHEN LAG(event_ts) OVER w IS NULL OR event_ts - LAG(event_ts) OVER w > INTERVAL '30 minutes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ns FROM app_events WHERE user_id IN (17, 128, 129, 278) AND event_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-11-01 00:00:00+00' AND event_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-12-01 00:00:00+00' WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_ts, event_id)),
s AS (SELECT *, SUM(ns) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_ts, event_id) AS sn FROM f)
SELECT user_id, CAST(sn AS INTEGER) AS session_no, MIN(event_ts) AS session_start, COUNT(*) AS events, CAST(epoch(MAX(event_ts) - MIN(event_ts)) AS BIGINT) AS length_seconds FROM s GROUP BY user_id, sn
